➡️@TexasChildrens announced their new COVID-19 vaccine was approved for emergency use authorization in India! This vaccine is an incredible breakthrough for the global health community & will help increase global vaccine supply to fight this pandemic. 
https://t.co/EBfRtB6iD5

I tested positive for COVID-19 this week and as a result will be voting by proxy next week for my health and the safety of others. I am fully vaccinated and boosted. Thankfully, I am recovering each day. I look forward to returning back to work for the people of TX-10.

We must increase global COVID-19 vaccine supply.I urge @POTUS to partner with efforts like  @TexasChildrens and @Baylor College of Medicine to ensure partners and allies have access to effective and low cost COVID-19 vaccines. https://t.co/hCOZhdxZNA

107,622 Americans died from drug overdose in 2021, and the fentanyl rampantly flowing across our southern border is the leading drug behind these deaths. @POTUS must secure our border and protect the American people from this deadly drug.https://t.co/8mSq83PfW5

The fentanyl rampantly flowing across our southern border knows no bounds, as teenage overdose death tragically skyrocket. This administration cannot ignore that our open border has deadly consequences for American families. https://t.co/Ebm6WiQo6h

Congratulations, @TexasChildrens, on being named the second-best pediatric hospital in the nation! Incredibly thankful for the Texas Children's team, who provides our kids with the highest level of care. https://t.co/hsd4dIoOXq

The average backpack is now $70, school supplies are up 15%, energy prices are through the roof, and the cost of food is astronomical. When will the admin learn that their economic policy is failing the American people? https://t.co/7t6zQPeS8n

It was an inspiring and emotional week on Capitol Hill as we gathered with advocates, survivors, and health care professionals to raise awareness for childhood cancer. I am proud to be a voice for children battling this disease, and I won’t stop until we’ve beaten cancer. https://t.co/AxE957btQU

Thirteen years ago, I founded the Childhood Cancer Caucus to give a voice to children battling cancer and the survivors who face lifelong health complications. It was an honor to meet with these young fighters and advocates to discuss the Give Kids a Chance Act. @KidsNBC https://t.co/aG6SvfrqCv

With energy costs skyrocketing, more than 1/3 of Americans are sacrificing basic needs like food and medicine to heat their homes.
 
It doesn't have to be this way. President Biden must unleash American energy!
https://t.co/p9hgdnnltc https://t.co/U4eeCmUf7E

President Biden's open border policies have brought tens of thousands of migrants to the border.

If Title 42 ends—like the admin wants—they will be released into our streets with nowhere to go.

This crisis is alarmingly inhumane and entirely preventable.
https://t.co/XI7aKw7cv4

¡Feliz día de los Reyes Magos! Happy #ThreeKingsDay! Wishing joy, health, and prosperity for all those who celebrate. 

“And going into the house, they saw the child with Mary his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him.” Matthew 2:11

Pres. Biden's anti-energy policies have brought us back to the Jimmy Carter days when the US depended on other nations.

We should not be dependent on foreign sources of energy, semiconductors, rare earth minerals, or medical supplies—all of which can be made right here at home. https://t.co/xzXZ0CUGif

I started the Childhood Cancer Caucus when I first joined Congress to provide hope and a brighter future — both to the thousands of kids diagnosed each year and the survivors who continue to face an uphill health battle.

Afghan women need real help. They’ve been forced into the shadows, with no rights or freedoms. Many are starving and don’t have access to health care. The admin needs a plan to both pressure the Taliban to restore rights and ensure aid gets to those who need it—not slogans.

Ending the federal government's COVID overreach:
 
✓Pandemic is Over Act—to end President Biden's public health emergency
✓SHOW UP Act—to get all employees of federal agencies back to work in person
 
Proud to be a part of all @HouseGOP is doing for the American people! 🇺🇸

Help prevent medication misuse and abuse by cleaning out your medicine cabinets this #TakeBackDay.

Collection sites located around the country will be open from 10 am-2 pm. Learn more: ⬇️ https://t.co/OEWGSS5luw

Proud to see the deepening of technology, education, & medical cooperation between Austin, TX, & Chiang Mai, Thailand. Thailand is a U.S. ally with a flourishing economy & vibrant culture. I look forward to working with my Thai counterparts to strengthen our countries' alliance.
Wishing all those who celebrate a Happy Lunar New Year! I hope the year of the dragon brings good health, peace, and prosperity for all.

On #RareDiseaseDay, I'm proud @HouseCommerce's Health Subcmte is considering 3 of my bills addressing rare pediatric diseases.

Together my Give Kids a Chance Act, Creating Hope Reauthorization Act, & Innovation in Pediatric Drug Act would work to save countless children's lives.

Our @CBP agents at the southern border witness human tragedies on every shift. It’s no wonder they’re experiencing a severe mental health crisis, as many agents have told me. The PEARL Act would support these heroes as they fight to protect our homeland. https://t.co/EtfABEBJTF

As more than 1 million Texans remain without power after Hurricane Beryl, high temperatures can be more dangerous than ever.

Click below to find power outage updates, open health clinics, and cooling center locations across the Houston area. https://t.co/6hYVC8ftVz

Constituents across the Brazos Valley have reported stories of bills, documents, & medication being delayed or lost in transit. These persistent issues are entirely unacceptable—especially for seniors, small businesses, & others who depend on @USPS services for their livelihoods.

Last week marked 12 years since Texan Mark Swidan was wrongfully detained in China.

Mark should be home with his family this Thanksgiving. Instead, he is languishing in a Chinese prison while his health declines rapidly.

I once again call on the CCP to immediately release Mark so he can return to his family in Texas where he belongs for the holidays.

As the son of a B-17 bombardier, I’m committed to ensuring the health and safety of the brave men and women who serve our country from the skies.
Proud to co-sponsor @RepPfluger’s ACES Act, which directs the VA secretary to investigate the high mortality and cancer incidence rates among aviators and aircrew who’ve served in the @USNavy, @USAirforce, and @USMC .
